Core ML models

What each model does

Eight containerized models run in your environment and write per-meter outputs to your data lake on every run. The examples use a synthetic home with the signatures the models detect in production data.

Use cases & MCP

Put it to work in Claude in minutes

Each use case combines model outputs, engines and your own data. Every one is also reachable through a UtilityAI Pro MCP server in your tenant, so your teams can connect it to Claude or any MCP-compatible agent and ask questions right away.

Deployment

How it maps to your environment

UtilityAI Pro ships as encrypted containers, pipelines and reference code that install into the cloud and data lake you already run. Change the environment at the top of the page to update this mapping.
